result.instructions: Tools for Precoro, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which purchase orders are waiting for my approval, and what do they total?"; "List the unpaid supplier invoices from the last 30 days."; "How much of each budget have we spent so far this quarter?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Precoro data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run precoro_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run precoro_request_feature to record the request. Paid options: a 7-day pass ($5 once, no subscription, unlimited calls for 7 days) or Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year). When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run precoro_upgrade (plan "pass", "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. precoro_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: precoro_list_purchase_orders
tools.title: List purchase orders
tools.description: List purchase orders (POs) with number (idn), supplier, location, totals, currency, required date, approval status, receiving status (0 not received, 1 partly, 2 received) and payment status (0 needs invoice, 1 not paid, 2 partly paid, 3 paid). Line items come only from precoro_get_purchase_order. Filter by status, last-modified time, approval date range, or 'waiting for my approval'. Page with next_page. GET /purchaseorders.

tools.name: precoro_approve_document
tools.title: Approve a document
tools.description: WRITE: approve a document as the Precoro user the API key belongs to (that user must be a current approver of it). Approving can release spending: an approved purchase order may be sent to the supplier and an approved invoice can go to payment. Find candidates with the list tools and waiting_for_my_approval. Cannot be undone through this server. POST /{document}/{idn}/approve.

document.description: Document type: warehouserequests, purchaserequisitions, purchaseorders, receipts, invoices or expenses.

idn.description: The document IDN: the company's own document number as shown in Precoro (not the internal id).

tools.name: precoro_reject_document
tools.title: Reject a document
tools.description: WRITE: reject (deny) a document that is waiting for the key user's approval. A comment is required; the creator is notified and sees it. POST /{document}/{idn}/reject.

document.description: Document type: warehouserequests, purchaserequisitions, purchaseorders, receipts, invoices or expenses.

idn.description: The document IDN: the company's own document number as shown in Precoro (not the internal id).

comment.description: Why it is rejected (required, up to 800 characters).

tools.name: precoro_submit_document
tools.title: Submit a draft for approval
tools.description: WRITE: confirm a draft (open) document so it enters the approval flow (or is approved at once if no approval is needed). Approvers are notified. POST /{document}/{idn}/confirm.

document.description: Document type: warehouserequests, purchaserequisitions, purchaseorders, receipts, invoices or expenses.

idn.description: The document IDN: the company's own document number as shown in Precoro (not the internal id).

tools.name: precoro_create_purchase_requisition
tools.title: Create a purchase requisition (draft)
tools.description: WRITE: create a purchase requisition in draft (open) status for the key user; it is not submitted for approval until precoro_submit_document is called. Needs a location id, a currency, a delivery date and at least one item (a catalog item_id, or a name with quantity and price). Find ids with precoro_list_reference_data (locations, legal_entities, document_custom_fields) and precoro_list_items. All required document custom fields (for example department or project) must be passed in custom_fields. Returns the new idn and id. POST /purchaserequisitions.

location_id.description: Location id (must be accessible to the key user).

legal_entity_id.description: Required when the company uses legal entities.

custom_fields.description: Document custom field values (department, project, GL account...). Every required one must be given.

value.description: Dropdown: the option id as text. Text: the text. Date: an ISO 8601 date.

item_id.description: A catalog item id; its name, SKU and type then come from the catalog.

price.description: Unit price in the document currency.

tools.name: precoro_create_supplier
tools.title: Create a supplier
tools.description: WRITE: create a supplier. The name must be unique in the company (a duplicate name, unique code or registration number is rejected). The supplier is available to all legal entities. Depending on the company's settings it may need approval before it can be used on orders. Returns the new supplier. POST /suppliers.

currencies.description: Currencies the supplier is paid in, e.g. ["USD"].

country.description: Country code or name as Precoro shows it, e.g. US.

contacts.description: Supplier contacts. Precoro can email purchase orders to them.
